findings.motion: HB 1263, verification of citizenship of an applicant for voter registration
findings.note: Bill filed by Schofield. The secretary of state would check an applicant's citizenship with the Department of Public Safety. An applicant the department cannot confirm would have 60 days to give proof (passport, birth certificate with photo ID, or citizenship papers with photo ID). Referred to the Elections committee 2025-03-10; no later action shown.
